title: Take a look at what’s in store at DataConnect 26

content.text: DataConnect, the flagship conference for the Office of the Chief Data Officer, returns next month.
The event programme has now been released; you can take a look and register today.

The conference has been curated around the theme: Data for growth, for people, for places. The conference brings together UK public sector data, digital, and AI professionals to explore real-world case studies and tangible outcomes delivered through public sector data. Anyone working in a public sector organisation can attend.
The programme will explore how data can deliver better outcomes for citizens, strengthen organisational capability, unlock innovation and support more joined-up public services.
Attendees described last year’s DataConnect as an event that "brought about connected thinking in a remote world" and noted that "DataConnect really connected people".
Others praised the practical nature of the sessions, highlighting the opportunity to hear from people who had delivered real-world solutions rather than simply discussing theory.
Attendees’ feedback on DataConnect25 revealed how much they valued the event:
These results underscore our commitment to fostering a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared freely.

This year, we aim to build on that momentum, providing even more opportunities for delegates to exchange ideas, tackle complex data challenges, and cultivate long-term partnerships that drive digital transformation across the UK public sector.
What to expect this year at DataConnect 26?

DataConnect 2026 offers two days of expert-led sessions, featuring discussions on data maturity, showcases of innovative AI prototypes from across the Civil Service, and strategic deep dives into building the UK's national data infrastructure.
Join public sector leaders to explore how we can turn data into a sustainable, strategic asset that drives growth, fosters innovation, and delivers better outcomes for citizens.

Join public sector data, digital, and AI professionals at this event to explore real-world case studies, exchange ideas, and cultivate long-term partnerships that drive digital transformation across the UK public sector.
You can take a further look at the programme and register today. We look forward to seeing you there!
